reports.text: The road is in good shape, with lots of turns.
Overall the scenery is excellent with lots of trees and beautiful views all along the way.
Watch the snowmelt, the blind curves, the rocks.
Road quality is good, you will find more than enough turns "sweeping and tight" to please anyone.
Travel up the Feather River Canyon through what has to be some of the most beautiful scenery in California.
Also there have been areas near the tunnels where large rocks or even an occasional landslide have fallen on the road surface.
